title: My Daughter Forged a Dissolution, Sold Our Workshop, and Mailed Me $3,200. So I Let Proof Speak.
description: After my daughter forged a dissolution to steal the $460,000 offer on our rocking horse business, I thought I'd lost everything. But I found our original contract hidden under a saddle, proved her forgery, and now she sands manes for me in a smock that says 'Unbridled Lies' while every hoof stamp prints her perjury case number. #FamilyBetrayal #Karma #RockingHorseJustice
thumb_text: I FOUND THE ORIGINAL CONTRACT HIDDEN UNDER A SADDLE
pinned_comment: If your own daughter forged a dissolution to steal your $112,000 retirement and a $460,000 offer, but you found the original contract under a saddle, what would you do? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE MAILED ME A $3,200 ROCKING CHECK AND THOUGHT SHE'D WON
